relations.text: AkamaiはAnthropicに、非議決権の転換型Series B優先株(完全転換ベースで普通株770万株分、最大約5%)の新株予約権を発行した
relations.text_en: Akamai issued Anthropic a warrant for non-voting convertible Series B Preferred Stock representing 7.7 million common shares as-converted, up to approximately 5%

source.label: Akamai Technologies 8-K Ex.99 の発表
source.quote: As part of the increased strategic alignment between Akamai and Anthropic, Akamai has issued a warrant to Anthropic for the purchase of non-voting convertible Series B Preferred Stock representing 7.7 million shares of Akamai’s common stock on an as-converted basis, or up to approximately 5% of

relations.text: AkamaiとAnthropicが複数年の契約を結んだ
relations.text_en: Akamai announced a multi-year agreement with Anthropic

source.label: Akamai Technologies 8-K Ex.99 の発表
source.quote: Multi-year Agreement with Anthropic to Support Growing Demand

relations.text: 年次報告で、NVIDIAなどの技術を用いたAkamaiの世界分散基盤により、AI推論の処理能力をデータの発生地点の近くに置くと説明している
relations.text_en: The annual report says AIC places AI inferencing capacity closer to where data is created, using Akamai's globally distributed infrastructure and architectures such as NVIDIA's

source.label: Akamai Technologies 10-K
source.quote: AIC addresses this need by leveraging Akamai’s expertise in globally distributed infrastructure and other architectures, such as those provided by NVIDIA, to place AI inferencing capacity and performance closer to where data is created and decisions need to be made.

relations.text: Akamai Inference Cloudは、Akamaiの分散基盤とNVIDIA Blackwell AI基盤を組み合わせて提供される
relations.text_en: Akamai Inference Cloud combines Akamai's globally distributed architecture with NVIDIA Blackwell AI infrastructure

source.label: Akamai Technologies 8-K Ex.99 の発表
source.quote: This launch of Akamai Inference Cloud leverages Akamai’s expertise in globally distributed architectures and NVIDIA Blackwell AI infrastructure to radically rethink and extend the accelerated computing needed to unlock AI's true potential.

relations.text: 年次報告で、Akamaiの販売チャネルパートナーの1社としてMicrosoft Azureを挙げている

source.quote: We market and sell our solutions globally through our field sales and services organization and through many channel partners, including adidas, AHEAD, Avant, BV Tech, Carahsoft, CPD, Deloitte, Deutsche Telecom, Doyen, Guidepoint, Kyndryl, LevelBlue, Macnica, Microsoft Azure, Netpoleon, Oplium, Optiv, Presidio, SHI, Telefonica Group, Trace3 and WWT.
source.note: チャネルパートナーとしての記載です。
